proof_body:
by
  intro f f' g a b hd hc hg hgf
  have hsub := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_deriv' hd hc hg
  have hcongr : (∫ x in a..b, (g ∘ f) x * f' x) = ∫ x in a..b, x * f' x := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x hx => ?_
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hgf x hx]
  have hparts := intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul (u := fun x => x) (v := f) (u' := fun _ => 1) (v' := f') (a := a) (b := b) (fun x _ => hasDerivAt_id' x) hd intervalIntegrable_const (ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable hc)
  simp only [one_mul] at hparts
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (f f' g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → ContinuousOn f' (Set.uIcc a b) → ContinuousOn g (f '' Set.uIcc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, g (f x) = x) → (∫ x in a..b, f x) + (∫ y in (f a)..(f b), g y) = b * f b - a * f a
